question: They join the epithelial cells to each other:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Cadherins -> form adherens junctions -> join epithelial cells to each other -> 95% CHAIN: Integrins -> connect extracellular matrix to the cell cytoskeleton -> not directly involved in joining epithelial cells to each other -> 70% CHAIN: Fibronectins -> bind to integrins -> help in cell adhesion and migration -> not directly involved in joining epithelial cells to each other -> 60% CHAIN: Elastins -> provide elasticity to tissues -> not involved in joining epithelial cells to each other -> 50% CHAIN: Laminins -> major components of basement membranes -> provide structural support to epithelial cells -> indirectly contribute to the connection between epithelial cells -> 95%
analysis: Cadherins are the proteins that join epithelial cells to each other through cell-cell adhesion.
